sentences.text:
Unknown vs Swami Sharma And Others Pending In The ... on 13
December, 2023

Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
 reports, orders
Sl. or proceedings
 Date Court'S Or Judges'S Order

S No or directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  13.12.2023 C-482 No.2385 of 2023  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Dr. Udyog Shukla, learned counsel, appear for the applicants.
2. Mr. M.A. Khan, learned Assistant Government Advocate with Ms. Minakshi Sharma, learned Brief Holder for the State, accepts notice on behalf of respondent No. 1.

3. Issue notice to respondent No. 2.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicants shall take steps, within a period of one week, to serve respondent No. 2 by registered post.

5. By the instant Application, preferred under Section 482 of Cr.P.C., the applicants are challenging the proceeding of Criminal Case No. 4208 of 2023 State vs. Swami Sharma and others pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the applicants submits that initiation of the proceeding pursuant to the FIR lodged by respondent No. 2 is a glaring example of malicious prosecution, which is evident from the fact that earlier on 18.10.2022 an FIR was lodged by applicant No. 1 against her husband Vivek Sharma, mother-in-law Shashi Bala and father-in-law D.D.Sharma with one Devendra Singh Parmar as accused No. 4 for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 377, 323, 506 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, at P.S. Kotwali Pilibhit bearing FIR No. 560 of 2022.

7. Vivek Sharma is the husband of applicant No. 1 and there is some matrimonial dispute between both of them and that is the reason, this FIR was lodged and Devendra Singh-the present respondent No. 2 was implicated because day to day he interfered in the family affairs of applicant No. 1.

Being prejudiced with the implication of respondent No. 2 in FIR No. 560 of 2022, which was lodged by applicant No.1 on 18.10.2022, respondent No. 2 lodged an FIR at P.S. Kashipur on 11.05.2023, which was registered as FIR No. 0229 of 2023,

wherein applicant No. 1-Swati Sharma,
Unknown vs Swami Sharma And Others Pending In The ... on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/70513453/
1 applicant No. 2-Mohit Gaur (the brother of Swati Sharma, Sanjeev Sharma (uncle of applicant No.1)
have been implicated.

In this FIR, it is alleged that on 25.08.2021, all these applicants called respondent No. 2 in the house of Vivek Sharma (husband of applicant No. 1) and they beaten him,
due to which, he sustained injuries.

Apart from this, another Application was moved by respondent No. 2- Devendra Singh under Section 155(2) of Cr.P.C. on 11.07.2022, wherein the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kashipur, on 14.10.2022, accepted this Application and granted permission to SHO, Kashipur to investigate NCR No. 11 of 2021 dated 25.08.2022.

on 11.05.2023, was investigated and subsequently, charge-sheet was filed and all the applicants were summoned by the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate on 09.11.2023 and being aggrieved with the initiation of this proceeding, the applicants have preferred the instant application under Section 482 of Cr.P.C.
9.

After examining the records and hearing the arguments of the learned counsel for the applicants,
there is no dispute that there is some matrimonial dispute of applicant No. 1 with her husband,
details of which have been given in Paragraph-10 of the affidavit.

10. On close scrutiny of the FIR lodged by respondent No. 2, it appears that the alleged incident was happened in the house of the husand of applicant No. 1-Mr. Vivek Sharma and this itself reveals that to some extent, respondent No. 2 was interfering with the family affairs of applicant No. 1 and that is the reason, respondent No. 2 was implicated along with the pursuant to the FIR lodged on 18.10.2022.
11.

Prima facie, this Court is of the view that initiation of this proceeding against the applicants pursuant to the FIR No. 229 of 2023 at P.S. Kashipur, District Udham Singh Nagar, in which charge-sheet was filed and the trial is going-on in Criminal Case No. 4208 of 2023 State vs. Swati Sharma and others appears to be a malicious prosecution.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
12. Let the counter-affidavits may be filed by the respondents within a period of three weeks.
13.
List this matter on 8th January, 2024.

14. In the meantime, further proceeding of Criminal Case No. 4208 of 2023 State vs. Swati Sharma and others, wherein the applicants are facing trial in respect of the offences punishable under Sections 324, 504 and 506 IPC pending in the Court of Additional Chief Judical Magistrate,
Kashipur, Udham Singh Nagar shall remain stayed qua the applicants.
